extracted.intended_audience: Assistant Deputy Director of Security for Personnel Security; CIA personnel responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA implementation memorandum describing the Division's contribution, emphasis, and reporting expectations for implementing OMB Circular A-44 (Revised, 16 Feb 1970).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide attached Division contribution to Subject report
rubrics_metrics.description: There is attached the contribution from this Division to the Subject report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the Division's written contribution is attached to the overall report on implementation; include whatever documentation the Division produced for the Subject report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary effort on management improvement over cost reduction
rubrics_metrics.description: The primary effort has been in management improvement rather than cost reduction goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame implementation measures and activities primarily as management/process improvements. Cost-reduction or savings are secondary and not the main objective; evaluation should emphasize management benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete implementation of measures set forth in Section I
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain man-hour savings may result from complete implementation of the measures set forth in Section I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carry out all measures enumerated in Section I to fully realize intended management improvements; reference Section I for the detailed measures to be implemented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report significant man-hour savings in subsequent reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Such savings, if significant, will be included in subsequent reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor and quantify any man-hour or other measurable savings resulting from implementation; if savings are significant, include them in follow-up/subsequent reports to headquarters or oversight as specified.
